newsitem.title: USA: US Attorney General to brief on ADM action.
newsitem.headline: US Attorney General to brief on ADM action.

text.p: U.S. Attorney General Janet Reno will hold a news conference Tuesday at noon to announce an enforcement action in Justice Department's investigation into the food and feed additives industries and into Archer Daniels Midland Co. (ADM.N).

ADM announced Monday it agreed to plead guilty to federal charges related to price-fixing in the lysine and citric acid food industies, and pay fines totalling $100 million, the biggest criminal antitrust fine in history.

Also participating in the news conference will be Joel Klein, Acting Assistant Attorney General of the Antitrust Division; Gary Spratling, Deputy Assistant Attorney General for the Division's Criminal Enforcement; U.S. Attorney James Burns of the Northern District of Illinois and FBI Assistant Director William Esposito.
